capabilities: Log time entries by dragging on an infinite-scroll timeline
Break down hours and billable amounts by client, project and activity in reports
Generate markdown invoices from billable client time
Detect and highlight overlapping time entries
Store entries as one markdown-table file per month
disambiguation: Not a stopwatch timer or task manager; entries are logged after the fact and tasks stay in external systems.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. A companion CLI (o-wdttg-cli) for AI agents is experimental and must currently be built from source. BRAT installation is documented for beta versions. No account, telemetry, or billing required; billing features can be disabled in settings.
motivation: The author was tired of SaaS trackers, subscriptions, Google Sheets, unneeded team features, and privacy emails, and wanted offline, instant, no-account tracking that stores data as plain markdown in the vault.
problem: Time-tracking apps are SaaS products with subscriptions, accounts, sync conflicts and slow loading, and Obsidian has no built-in way to log hours and bill clients.

relations.evidence: companion command-line tool, o-wdttg-cli, that exposes this plugin through the new Obsidian CLI

summary: Time-tracking plugin with an infinite-scroll timeline, hierarchical reports, and markdown invoice generation, storing entries as monthly markdown tables in the vault.
